sources: Screenshots use judges source images and the real engine-computed registration. Browser HTTP transport is isolated; no shared server chats/uploads are created.
shared_component: SheetCompare files taken from final/mirror-changes at 9603fa9; overlay wraps it without editing its API.
limitations: Sports Complex early-to-later revision: insufficient automatic raster features; manual two-point fit shown, independent third-corner discrepancy 11.18 px; no accuracy claim.
Anchor consensus percentage describes correspondence support, not measurement accuracy.
Chat overlay actions and manual fits stay in the current browser session; no backend chat history write.
pipeline.pdf_mep is not present in fetched awais/pdf3d; provider_alignment adapter supports its promised T/residual/matches return shape; current text/raster fallback is active.
